product_summary: Ubatuba is a dark green Brazilian granite with gold flecks that's popular for kitchen countertops due to its durability and budget-friendly pricing. Its dense composition often eliminates the need for sealing, making it lower-maintenance than many other granite varieties.

beats_expectations: Some premium fabricators offer lifetime sealing coverage that eliminates resealing requirements
underperforms_expectations: No manufacturer warranty exists - you're entirely dependent on your local fabricator's terms
Natural color variation between slabs is explicitly excluded from all warranties
surprises: Warranty typically covers only installation workmanship for 1-15 years, not the stone itself
Coverage doesn't transfer if you sell your home

buyer_considerations.text: Significant color variation between slabs can create unexpected seams - request sequential slab numbers from same quarry bench during fabrication
Many granite sealers contain PFAS 'forever chemicals' linked to health issues, though Ubatuba's density may eliminate sealing need entirely
Service quality depends entirely on your local fabricator since there's no centralized manufacturer support network

serviceability_summary: No centralized service network - you're dependent on your local fabricator's skill and longevity for any future repairs or matching
material_health_summary: Stone itself poses minimal health risks per EPA assessment, but common granite sealers contain PFAS chemicals - Ubatuba's low porosity often eliminates sealing need and exposure pathway
